_description: Permanent denylist plus the memory of past decisions. `discover` skips listed owners; `report` skips commits already decided. Written by the `mark` subcommand - safe to edit by hand.

20245100e0423262d8e4b3b1a714db56a1ad2289.note: reimplemented as a03da0082 (original targeted mRemoteV1 tree)

7746827c2b4af03f16d59fe482cb6f050bef70c9.note: a non-switch token is kept whole, so a Windows path survives the colon

f634039a177f9204454e5fd8680b3cce3ee50863.note: OpenSSH uses the same SCP and SFTP window as SSH1 and SSH2

85056294af97fa3ad7316a36097e0d38f67a9500.note: shutdown writes a save that is still waiting on the debounce timer

c4d0596f2485d6493ea30bd27219f40c2a068759.note: a cancelled close activates the tab that stays

0121f0be4cea9a485f91f41d2bae56ea2b288f65.note: a scan that cannot start names the reason and does not change the button

dd54616a2e47bdb94e18b2fbafbd2a30764a3728.note: a failed legacy decrypt returns no tree instead of throwing

53451f91f5195273903d0ac51e92ec1ee45e13ab.note: a main window with no remembered size opens at 90 percent of the working area

004526376515164a858c98a9a1c782d04a28c33c.note: the Advanced page names the detected PuTTY path

c4837b6551b9d8fe8ffc9980159905d0442824f3.note: the command button measures its large line the way it is drawn

739847ef5a331f124a67e09d20f59c478f54adf0.note: the themed command button draws a focus ring inside its face

2a900303298b1f4583b2c74ad65373d7c4ab140d.note: the themed command button draws a focus ring inside its face

d500a8e9dda08af453e3e69f3d891e2be4145686.note: a relative connections file is shown as its full path in the window title

6c1dbeaf8209f23145c456805bb5cd72d03cff32.note: the sole-candidate test calls Resolve with a synthetic candidate and does not read the machine disk

eb03e059b2ecc1a1b00dc70056b70cdb348a2195.note: Appearance can choose the interface font and the choice is applied on save and at startup

3f94a2c23980a384cbf15386ae7ffc506a92e6e5.note: The theme option follows the Windows app setting and applies through the existing live theme event. The saved theme name is kept.

1329450e782556cc4fdc33bd916aedabe9434064.note: A dark dialog background asks open forms, floating windows and task dialogs for a dark title bar. Native controls follow the same choice.

4edeaba5c11fe819d1cf1fd37584e6b4fa79c325.note: A panel that changes while a session size is applied schedules another pass.

08b056f698587be31a2582070549e24dc7147fcb.note: The session size is the panel client area minus the frame padding, not the ActiveX control size.

9216eeec3fc53ba08f2ea15804a58983916a8f6e.note: FitToWindow on RDP 8 does not apply a session size, because that client would have to reconnect. RDP 9 still updates the display in place.

42f6eaaf62bcc6cd83538304a1c0b8184eb50f6c.note: Every notification is queued in one locked order. One drain renders them oldest first, including messages reported on the UI thread.

b1e1dcfe5db54b1acd6d191c57dd3980a38ab3cf.note: A PseudoConsoleWindow left by a handed-off console is not docked. The tool keeps running in its own window and the panel is not left empty.

_owner_note: Add an owner here only for sustained noise or hostile behaviour, with a reason in _owner_reasons.
